step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows an on-premises database connecting to an AWS Storage Gateway, which transfers data via Direct Connect into an AWS S3 Landing bucket. From there, data is processed by Quality Cleansing EC2 instances interacting with an RDS metadata database, and stored in a Transformation S3 bucket. Transformation EC2 instances read from the Transformation S3 bucket, interact with RDS, and load transformed data into Amazon Redshift. Data from Redshift is published to a Publish S3 bucket, which transitions aged data to Glacier.
